data.title: 妮姆芙 · 晨曦微风中的薯片软糖小憩
data.description: 清晨的薄风拂过阳台的浅蓝窗纱，妮姆芙侧卧在铺满柔软靠垫的地毯上。宽松的浅蓝棉质睡衫滑落一边肩头，小巧精致的锁骨与雪肌分外惹人怜爱。透明羽翼如披风般半掩在身后，她单手抱着最心爱的草莓零食袋，另一只手揉着微睡的眼睛，嘴角泛起初醒时的香甜微笑，像一只终于找到避风港的精灵鸟儿。
data.location: bright peaceful morning bedroom filled with sunshine
data.action: lying on plush rug in morning sunlight, oversized pastel blue nightshirt slipping off shoulder, hugging snack bag, holographic wings resting on floor, sleepy adorable smile
data.lighting: pure morning sunbeams illuminating floating dust motes and soft blue hair
data.mood: precious peaceful shelter, heartwarming innocent morning joy
data.promptProse: Lounging on a fluffy carpet in warm morning sunbeams, Nymph wears an oversized pastel nightshirt slipping off one bare shoulder. Her transparent wings rest softly as she cuddles a snack pillow with an adorable sleepy smile.
data.animaCaption: Nymph lounging on a sunlit rug in an oversized pastel shirt, smiling happily with glowing wings.
